column1: # SSF2T (arcade `ssf2t`) ARRANGE trigger map: standalone arcade stage command
#   -> HSF2 AE ARRANGE-bank ADX entry (the console-arranged SF2 soundtrack).
# SOURCE IDENTITY (internal research notes): the HSF2 AE arrange
#   bank IS the SSF2/SSF2T arrangement.  This is a RE-KEY of the HSF2 arrange
#   ssf2t arcade QSound stage commands.  ADX audio + Capcom header loop points
#   * Standalone `ssf2t` QSound sound-test sweep (latch-poke harness; trace/
#     sweep.lua) -> per-command clips in the internal listening archive, each
#     cross-correlated (log-RMS envelope NCC) against the LABELLED HSF2 CPS2-bank
#     recordings (entry 71=Ken .. 86=Dee-Jay = same QSound masters ssf2t emits):
#     cmd 0x01..0x10 identify as the 16 SF2 characters in EXACT HSF2 order,
#     NCC 0.79-0.98.  ssf2 and ssf2t give byte-for-byte-identical id results
#     (same 1.04 driver).  Commands 0x11..0x40 are noise-grade vs every stage
#     ref (menu/vs/select/continue/ending music -> pass through to QSound);
#   * IN-GAME ANCHOR: drove `ssf2t` into a real match (Ryu vs Zangief on
#     Zangief's stage, on-screen snapshot); kind=0 stage BGM cmd 0x06 issued at
#     stage start — matching the sound-test id 0x06=Zangief.  Confirms
# GOUKI / AKUMA (flagged): the HSF2 arrange bank has a "STAGE GOUKI" theme
#   (arrange entry 67, cmd 0xd5 in HSF2's unified numbering; CPS2-bank twin =
#   entry 137).  NO standalone-ssf2t command in the swept range 0x01..0x80 plays
#   a theme matching that recording (best NCC vs the Gouki ref anywhere = 0.36,
#   noise-grade).  Consistent with the known history that original SSF2T has no
#   dedicated Akuma stage BGM (HSF2 AE ADDED the arranged Gouki theme).  Akuma is
#   a hidden boss who ambushes on M. Bison's FINAL stage, so the arcade emits
#   M. Bison's stage command 0x09 during the Akuma fight -> the pack plays
#   M. Bison's arrange (e9) there, matching the arcade (human-confirmed by
#   gameplay video, 2026-07).  Already covered by row 0x09; no cmd->entry pair is
#   invented for Gouki, and no Akuma-specific command exists to add.
# JOIN: cmd 0xNN -> HSF2 arrange entry NN for the 16 SF2 stages (Ken-first).
# Consumed by pack/build_ssf2_arrange.py (cols: cmd, arrange_entry, character,
# Extends coverage to the hurry-ups, endings and UI music (0x11-0x3f).
# The standalone driver's mapped music normally follows HSF2's unified layout:
# Identified per-clip with tools/align_ncc.py against the album's CPS2 bank
# (the same QSound masters this board plays); control on the 16 stages: 16/16.
# Command 0x3d is the exception: a natural attract trace proves that SSF2T
# sends 0x3d followed by 0xd1 for the QSound-logo sequence.  HSF2 Arrange entry
# 61 is one second of silence, so 0x3d must remain unmapped and fail open to
# QSound.  Command 0x40 also remains unmapped because the album has no
# SSF2T NOTE 1: the 0x11-0x40 clips in ssf2t_arcade_id/ were
# COPIES of the ssf2 files (byte-identical), not captures; this extension is
# from a genuine re-sweep (scratchpad ssf2t_resweep, MAME 0.288 ssf2t).
# NOTE 2: at 0x35/0x36/0x38/0x39/0x3a/0x3f Turbo plays 1-4 s STINGERS where
# SSF2 plays full tracks; mapped to the full arranged tracks anyway -- the
# next PLAY command replaces them, so the screen length rules, not the row.
